name: Lost order ~Last Smile~
source:
The Kingdom of Kasimar is home to pent-up air, purple smoke, and fragile humans.

This country flourished thanks to advances in chemistry
Because of its richness that sets it apart from other countries 【Arcadia - Utopia -】
I was called that in the past.

Meteorite makes unusual approach to star
【Phobos Night 】by
All aspects of the world, including this country, have crumbled fragilely and fleetingly.

Although the meteorite did not hit the star
During an anomalous approach, this planet
He spread unknown and strange diseases.

The name of the disease is 【Kassimar】

It is attached to the genes of infected people
A nightmare disease that causes malignant mutations

It acts on each individual's genome, but
The symptoms are so varied that it distorts even the form of a person
Modern medicine has no magic,
It quickly spread throughout the world.

About 10 years since the night of Phobos
Casimar lost thousands of people and engineers,
The royal majesty has fallen to the earth

Private companies dominate this lawless country
: Shelm = Legato

They began shortly after night on Phobos
Using the vast amount of supplies that had begun to be stored as bait,
